title: Podcast Queue Snapshot Status Mix
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=podcast:queue
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(queue_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the podcast queue snapshot feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `queue_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It builds the overall mood of your podcast queue snapshot feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
